items.title: Birthday Surprise!
items.summary: A group of adventuring friends show up to surprise their wizardly friend at home. But can they find their way once inside his magical tower?

items.title: Hero and Apothecary: The Warded Woods
items.summary: Four young men go to a mystic forest for initiation, but when two refuse to participate, a conflict breaks out among them.This is a collaboration between GalacticKit and StarrcrossRose under the name StarrKit Productions for Andy Cung's First Story Academy Student Showcase. It is part of a proof of concept for an independent animated pilot.
